notes.title: Skeleton Dungeon Patch Note - Version 1.1
notes.content: [p]•Fix the yellow skeletons projectile staying between level transitions.[/p][p]•Make the yellow skeletons projectile spawn away from the player.[/p][p]•Buff enemies score value.[/p][p]•Fix the eye portal from spawning on the next stage after you collect 3 eyes.[/p][p]•Slightly increase sword hitbox.[/p][p]•Added skeleton break table.[/p]
